title: Gray Glass Mosaic Kitchen Backsplash in Arlington
summary: Kitchen backsplash update featuring a gray glass mosaic installed between the countertops and upper cabinets for a modern reflective finish.
problem: The kitchen wall needed a durable backsplash that would complement the existing cabinets, countertops and stainless-steel appliances.
solution: Installed gray glass mosaic tile with careful layout, cuts and grout joints throughout the backsplash area.
